title: mimulus guttatus var. hallii
intro: Mimulus guttatus var. hallii, commonly known as Western monkey flower, is a plant species native to the western coast of North America. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat anxiety, stress, and emotional imbalances due to its reported health benefits, including reducing symptoms of anxiety and depression. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include iridoid glycosides, specifically mimosine and aucubin, that have been shown to possess anti-anxiety and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Mimulus guttatus var. hallii may contribute to its traditional use in herbal medicine as a calming agent and emotional balancer.
